overall: The AG resolved the complaint by informal action, finding the Everett Board of Licensing Commissioners violated the Open Meeting Law when all three members certified late or not at all; removal and vacatur were rejected, and compliance was ordered.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that all three Board members did not comply with the Open Meeting Law certification requirements; members certified more than a year or several weeks late.
allegations.key_passage: For the reasons stated above, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law when all of its members failed to comply with the certification requirements of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: To the extent the complaint alleged that individuals who are not Board or other public body members violated the Open Meeting Law, the AG declined review.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we decline to review any allegation that individuals who are not members of the Board, or another public body, violated the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a note that future similar violations may be considered evidence of an intent to violate the law.
remedy_passage: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and note that future similar violations may be considered evidence of an intent to violate the law.
